title: Searching is cheaper than shifting
hook: Finding a gap and making room are different kinds of work.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Separate binary insertion's reduced comparisons from its unchanged element movement.

misconception: A logarithmic insertion-position search makes the whole insertion logarithmic.
objective: Separate binary insertion's reduced comparisons from its unchanged element movement.

claims.text: Binary search finds the gap with a few comparisons, but the suffix still has to move. Reducing comparison work does not remove the movement cost of inserting inside an array.
